notes: Shells that have opted into the self-contained pattern. Only showcase_notes_shell qualifies today: it is the one shell with a real widget home (shared/widgets/ for cross-surface components, <surface>/widgets/ for surface-local ones, each with a widgets.dart barrel) and a design-system.md read out of its own source. showcase_home_shell, showcase_profile_shell, showcase_search_shell and showcase_application_shell have zero widgets and no design-system.md — listing them would assert a migration that has not happened, and the gate fails on a manifest naming a shell that isn't really self-contained. Until this file existed, shell_structure_gate.sh S1-S9 were a NO-OP on the kit's own exemplar: the corpus that kit-feature-implementer/SKILL.md:82,87 and kit-reviewer/SKILL.md:45 cite by path was never itself checked against the rules those docs describe.
